therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: demethylation of p16 tumor suppressor gene
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: restoration of p16 tumor suppressor function to prevent cancer recurrence
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with stage I-IV head and neck cancer undergoing surgery
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: mean percent change in p16 methylation in tumor tissue

results.target_engagement_evidence: 4.9% change in p16 methylation in tumor tissue
biomarker_changes: correlations assessed with serum/saliva markers of p16, IL6, and VEGF
subgroup_findings: differential effects analyzed between smokers and non-smokers
results.dose_information: given orally, specific dose not provided

context.duration: treatment up to 42 days pre-surgery, follow-up up to 24 months
